caption: All support panels show pointwise 95% Wilson intervals. (a,b) N=2 Poisson and Poisson plus two-electron rms read noise per pixel: all seven total two-frame photon budgets 1e5..1e11, five methods, 200 paired trials per budget within each noise family (7000 records each). Poisson and mixed do not reuse identical shot-noise draws; their difference is not a paired read-noise-only effect. (d) Full fixed-separation sweep at 60 dB, N=2: separations 2,4,5,6,8, five methods, 100 trials each (2500 displayed records from the complete 26500-row mismatch suite). Shading marks separation at most 2N=4, outside the sufficient strict-separation condition. (c) Fixed 2D synthetic common-signature, nonnegative-strength case with known phase and exact blank calibration: six budgets 6e7..2e10, 200 noise realizations each, calibrated and +2% assumed-gamma reconstructions (2400 records), not general complex 2D recovery. Photon axes display log10 of total expected photons over the same two frames; the small legend in (c) is separate from the five-method benchmark legend.
